This '''canyon''' was a steep and barren geographical feature on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A [[bridge]], which marked one end of [[Widow's Valley]], crossed over the [[canyon]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the bridge was [[Battle of the south ridge|destroyed]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], who was engaging a [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] convoy.

==Behind the scenes==
This featureless canyon and the bridge is briefly seen in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
